prompts.archer:
Create a production-ready PHOTOREALISTIC cinematic animation pose atlas, NOT pixel art, NOT cartoon, NOT illustration. True transparent background. Square atlas divided into an EXACT 3 by 3 equal-cell grid, 9 cells, NO visible grid, NO text, NO borders. Each cell contains the SAME original adult Korean female competitive archer with long dark flowing hair seen FROM BEHIND, over-rear-right camera viewpoint, facing away and slightly toward screen-right toward a distant target. She wears an ivory fitted long-sleeve technical archery jersey with small deep-red and navy shoulder/waist accents, black protective chest guard and wrist guard, dark trousers. Athletic realistic anatomy. No logos. Cool blue cinematic rim light, warm highlight on hair and fabric, premium night-sports film look. Frame from hips upward, entire curved recurve bow and both hands included, do not crop bow or hair; identical camera, scale, hip anchor, body position and lighting in all 9 cells; sufficient transparent padding in each cell. The bow is held in her extended left arm, right hand pulls string toward her jaw, bow aims away forward-right. Physically credible string tension, slim carbon arrow aligned with bow hand, limbs and hands anatomically correct. Her face is not visible.
READING ORDER poses:
1 top-left: relaxed rear-view preparing, bow lowered slightly, long hair hanging straight.
2 top-middle: same preparation, hair and sleeve move subtly in breeze, different actual hair shape.
3 top-right: raises bow and sets left shoulder, right hand begins to take string.
4 middle-left: partially drawn string, right elbow moving backward, upper back engaged.
5 middle-center: deeper draw, right hand nearing jaw anchor, left arm firm.
6 middle-right: full tension, right hand anchored at jaw, full bowstring draw, focused still pose.
7 bottom-left: just released, right fingers visibly opening, string springs forward, NO nocked arrow, hair whips left.
8 bottom-center: follow-through, right hand recoils naturally behind ear, hair flows dramatically left, NO nocked arrow.
9 bottom-right: settle after shot, right arm lowered slightly, hair easing, bow still extended, NO nocked arrow.
Deliver sharp high-resolution realistic cutouts with true alpha; cinematic photographic texture, graceful natural female athlete rather than action-game hero. Nine distinct actual body/arm/bow/hair poses, not rotated or translated copies. Never include arena, target, shadows on background, colored squares, a pixel grid, UI or captions.
prompts.arena: Create a high-resolution 16:9 wide photorealistic cinematic background plate for a premium nighttime archery sports film. An EMPTY straight archery shooting lane runs from the foreground into the distance, centered vanishing point slightly right of center. Dark navy and charcoal stadium, subtle distant audience silhouettes in stands, cool blue floodlights with restrained warm gold highlights, realistic textured grass/turf in the foreground, distant concrete arena walls, atmospheric haze and tasteful shallow-depth-of-field bokeh. View at athlete shoulder height looking straight downrange. Keep central area readable and clear so an archer cutout can be placed foreground-left and a target can be added separately in distance, including central crop for phone portrait. No people in foreground, no archer, NO TARGET anywhere, no arrows, no logos, no text, no sports team branding, no HUD. Dramatic realistic light and quiet focused tension, not fantasy, not 3D game, NOT pixel art, NOT illustration. No radiating sun rays or red-and-white radial backgrounds.
prompts.target: Create a high-resolution photorealistic isolated archery target FACE, perfectly FRONT-ON, perfectly circular, centered with generous even transparent padding. True transparent background. Real regulation-style concentric target zones: outer ivory white, charcoal black, saturated muted blue, deep red, small warm gold/yellow bullseye exactly in geometric center. Fine realistic woven paper/fiber texture and slight used surface marks, thin dark charcoal rim. Cool blue rim light and gentle warm frontal highlight matching a night sports stadium film. A single complete circular disc only. NO stand, NO arrow, NO numerals, NO letters, NO logos, NO center dot button, NO extra objects, no backdrop, no box. High-end photographic asset, NOT pixel art, not cartoon, not illustration. Straight front-on geometry is essential for an arrow hitting precise center and later radial pixel transformation.
prompts.arrow: A single premium PHOTOREALISTIC competition archery arrow, horizontally oriented, tail on LEFT and sharp tip on RIGHT. Isolated with TRUE transparent background. Straight thin dark carbon shaft with subtle reflective metallic highlight, tiny steel conical tip, three small realistic ivory and deep-red feather/plastic vanes at tail, black nock. The shaft lies exactly on horizontal centerline. Extreme width-to-height ratio, arrow occupies at least 85 percent image width with generous transparent padding above/below. Side view with tiny three-quarter perspective on fletching, cinematic cool-blue rim light and warm highlight, premium sports photography at night. Nothing else. NO bow, NO hands, NO target, NO lettering, NO brand logos, NOT pixel art, NOT vector illustration, NOT cartoon, NOT medieval fantasy weapon. Realistic aerodynamic proportions with small vanes, no exaggerated triangular flag feathers. Asset for embedding exactly into target center.
